item.title: The Prusa CORE One+ Up Close: A 55 °C Heated Chamber and What Else Sets It Apart
item.description: The Prusa CORE One+ is an enclosed CoreXY workhorse with an actively heated 55 °C chamber. Here's what the chamber unlocks, what the '+' added, and the features that actually matter — plus the honest trade-offs.

item.title: Why an 8-Tool Prusa INDX Might Be My Next Printer
item.description: The Prusa/Bondtech INDX adds up to 8 independent toolheads to a CORE One+ for true multi-material printing. Here's why the ~$999 8-tool kit is on my upgrade shortlist — and why 'Nozzlegate' means it isn't in my cart yet.

item.title: The P1S AMS 2 Pro Combo Is $579. The P2S Combo Is $749. Here's Which One to Buy.
item.description: Bambu dropped the P1S to $399 and the AMS 2 Pro combo to $579. The P2S combo is $749. That $170 gap is the whole buying decision, and the answer isn't what the spec sheet suggests.

item.title: Bambu Lab's New Printer Lineup: H2D, H2S, and the Brand-New X2D Explained
item.description: Bambu Lab replaced their entire prosumer lineup in 12 months. Here's what's new, what each machine does, and which one makes sense for your setup.

item.title: PLA vs PETG: Which 3D Printing Filament Should You Use?
item.description: PLA or PETG? Here's what the difference actually is, which one to start with, and the best filaments to buy on Amazon.

item.title: What is ASA Filament? When to Stop Using PETG for Outdoor Prints
item.description: ASA filament is the go-to material for outdoor 3D prints. Here's what it is, why it beats PETG outdoors, and what you need to print it successfully.

item.description: The printer, nozzles, and filament I use for everyday printing.
